GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 400.12 (8 Nov 48) CTS
(SCAPIN - 1953/1)
APO 500
7 October 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Establishment of an Adequate Procurement Policy for the Japanese National Railways.
1. Reference SCAPIN 1953, 30 Dec 1948, file AG 400. 12 (8 Nov 48) CTS-R, above subject.
2. The plan as submitted by the Japanese National Railway in compliance with paragraph 3 of SCAPIN 1953 for provision of open competitive bidding on all material purchases and sales and all construction and maintenance contracts by the Japanese National Railways is approved.
3. This plan will be put into effect immediately upon receipt of this directive.
4. The Japanese Government is authorized direct communication with Civil Transportation Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, in the implementation of this plan.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
